title: Windgram observation document

model.description: Lowercase hyphenated slug — the identity of models and sites everywhere.

firstObservedAt.description: UTC instant, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix; fractional seconds tolerated.

lastObservedAt.description: UTC instant, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix; fractional seconds tolerated.

generatedAt.description: When the pipeline generated this document, UTC.

observed.description: The observation window and generation instant — the observation kind's replacement for a run block. The window rolls; the provider's own archive is the permanent record.

id.description: Lowercase hyphenated slug — the identity of models and sites everywhere.

timeZone.description: The site's IANA timezone, echoed from the sites.json catalogue.

observedAt.description: Observation instant, UTC — the product's own timestamp, at its native cadence.

downwardShortwaveWm2.description: Measured downward shortwave flux at the surface, W/m² (GOES-R ABI L2 DSR). Daytime product: instants without a good-quality retrieval are absent from the series — "not measured", never zero.

observedAt.description: Observation instant, UTC — the product's own timestamp, at its native cadence.

aot.description: Measured aerosol optical thickness at 550 nm (GOES-R ABI L2 AOD, high+medium quality) — the same quantity and wavelength a smoke document forecasts as aot. Daytime product: instants without an accepted retrieval are absent — "not measured", never clear air.

observations.description: Chronological measured instants at product cadence. Gaps are real: an absent instant had no good-quality retrieval (night, quality flags, scan gaps).

description: Per-site satellite observation time series (GOES-18 ABI L2 downward shortwave today), published at <model-slug>/sites/<site-slug>.json — measurements, not forecasts; join to profile or smoke documents by instant.
